name: Country Ripe Tomatoes
description: Sweet, juicy, and vine-ripened organic country tomatoes. Freshly harvested every morning, perfect for gravies, salads, and rasam.

name: Farm Fresh Red Potatoes
description: Naturally grown unpolished red potatoes with high starch content, perfect for roasting, baking, or Indian curries.

name: Small Sambar Shallots (Onions)
description: Pungent, authentic South Indian small shallots packed with immune-boosting allicin. An absolute necessity for traditional sambar.

name: Sweet Ooty Orange Carrots
description: Highland Ooty carrots grown in volcanic mountain soil. Extremely sweet, tender, crunchy, and rich in beta-carotene.

name: Crisp Green Cabbage
description: Tight, dense heads of cool-season cabbage harvested before morning dew. Ideal for stir-fries, poriyal, and slaws.

name: Fresh Snow-White Cauliflower
description: Blemish-free snowy white cauliflower heads wrapped in crisp green protective leaves. Chemical and pesticide free.

name: Tender Purple Brinjal (Eggplant)
description: Glossy, seedless, tender purple brinjals. Perfect for South Indian Ennai Kathirikai or Baingan Bharta.

name: Crisp Tender Okra (Ladies Finger)
description: Freshly snapped young okra pods with zero stringiness. Perfect for dry pan roasting or tangy tamarind curries.

name: Deep Crimson Beetroots
description: Rich, earthy, antioxidant-loaded crimson beetroots. Excellent for daily detox juices, salads, and warm coconut poriyals.

name: Spicy Fresh Green Chillies
description: Vibrant, sharp, and aromatic green chillies picked fresh from sunny fields to bring natural heat to any dish.

name: Alphonso Mango (Hapus)
description: The king of mangoes. Naturally tree-ripened without calcium carbide, boasting unmatched golden sweetness and rich aroma.

name: Robusta Golden Bananas
description: Potassium-rich, energy-boosting naturally ripened Robusta bananas grown along the fertile Kaveri river banks.

name: Crisp Shimla Royal Apples
description: Sweet, fragrant, and juicy mountain-grown apples with a satisfying crunch. Zero wax coating or artificial shine.

name: Juicy Nagpur Oranges
description: Plump and burst-in-your-mouth citrus oranges loaded with Vitamin C. Perfect for morning freshly squeezed juices.

name: Seedless Black Grapes (Sharad)
description: Crispy, sweet, dark purple seedless grapes with an intense natural sugar profile and protective natural bloom.

name: Striped Sweet Watermelon
description: Whole round watermelons with deep red, juicy, and crystalline sweet flesh. 92% hydration naturally harvested.

name: Red Lady Sweet Papaya
description: Smooth skin and bright orange-red buttery flesh. High in papain enzymes, exceptional for digestion and skin vitality.

name: Country White Guava
description: Traditional crispy country guavas with four times more Vitamin C than oranges. Season with pinch of salt & chilli.

name: Vazhakulam Queen Pineapple
description: Golden, fragrant Queen pineapples famed for their tender core, aromatic punch, and intoxicating tropical sweetness.

name: Ruby Red Pomegranate
description: Thin-skinned Bhagwa variety filled with soft, dark ruby edible seeds brimming with heart-healthy polyphenols.

name: Aged Thanjavur Ponni Rice
description: Naturally aged for 12 months in aerated silos. Fluffy, non-sticky, fragrant grains that swell beautifully on cooking.

name: Sharbati Golden Whole Wheat
description: Premium whole grain wheat harvested from rain-fed black soils. Yields velvety, pillowy soft rotis and rotis.

name: Sun-Dried Sweet Yellow Corn (Maize)
description: Dry farm maize kernels ideal for home stone-milling into gluten-free makki flour or healthy breakfast porridge.

name: Ancient Native Finger Millet (Ragi)
description: Unprocessed ancient red ragi kernels. Rich in natural calcium (344mg/100g) and ideal for diabetic-friendly porridge and mudde.

name: Country Pearl Millet (Bajra)
description: Hardy whole pearl millet grains loaded with iron and magnesium. Helps maintain energy and warmth throughout the day.

name: Great White Sorghum (Jowar)
description: 100% naturally gluten-free white whole jowar grains. Great for cholesterol balance and gut-friendly rotis.

name: Hulled Pearled Barley (Jau)
description: Cooling, diuretic, and high beta-glucan barley grains. Simmer into restorative barley water or wholesome grain bowls.

name: Whole Grain Rolled Oats
description: Kiln-steamed thick rolled oats with bran intact. Creates creamy, long-lasting breakfast porridge supporting cardiovascular wellness.

name: Organic Foxtail Millet (Thinai)
description: Golden tiny ancient seeds praised in Sangam literature. Low glycemic index and rich in nervous-system supporting thiamine.

name: Little Millet (Samai Grains)
description: Fast-cooking, fluffy little millet grains. Replaces white rice effortlessly for wholesome lemon rice, upma, and payasam.

name: Unpolished Desi Toor Dal
description: Zero oil polish, naturally split pigeon peas. Cooks into thick, aromatic sambar with unmistakable home-cooked fragrance.

name: Golden Yellow Moong Dal
description: Skinless split yellow gram with gentle digestive properties. Essential for piping hot Ven Pongal and light kootu.

name: Whole White Urad Dal (Gundu)
description: High-viscosity round white urad dal that ferments into the fluffiest Mallipoo Idlis and crisp Medu Vadas.

name: Split Bengal Gram (Chana Dal)
description: Nutty, robust split chickpeas. Ideal for crisp Masala Vada batters, crunchy tempering, and protein rich dal curries.

name: Red Masoor Dal (Split)
description: Fast-cooking pink lentils that melt into velvety, creamy textured soups and North Indian style tadka dals in 15 minutes.

name: Kabuli White Chickpeas (Chole)
description: Large-grain creamy white chickpeas that expand evenly without skins bursting. Perfect for Punjabi Chole and smooth hummus.

name: Whole Green Mung Beans
description: 100% germination rate whole green mung beans. Ready to sprout in 24 hours into crunchy, live-enzyme health salads.

name: Whole Black Gram with Husk
description: Unskinned black urad grains packed with dietary fiber and bone-strengthening minerals. Base for comforting Dal Makhani.

name: Red Kidney Beans (Chitra Rajma)
description: Speckled Himalayan Chitra variety known for its melt-in-mouth buttery softness and rich gravy infusion.

name: Native Brown Cowpeas (Karamani)
description: Traditional village karamani beans. Highly valued for postpartum strength, festival sundal, and spicy coconut gravies.

name: Fresh A2 Desi Cow Milk
description: Pure, unadulterated raw milk from grass-fed Kangayam cows. Chilled directly to 4°C within 15 minutes of dawn milking.

name: Clay-Pot Set Thick Curd
description: Natural live probiotic curd cultured in breathable earthenware pots. Thick, spoonable, and perfectly balanced acidity.

name: Soft Fresh Malai Paneer
description: Hand-pressed artisanal cottage cheese made from whole cow milk and natural lemon whey. Melts gently in rich gravies.

name: Farmhouse Fresh White Butter (Makhan)
description: Traditional bilona-churned unsalted white butter made from cultured cream. Perfect atop hot parathas or dosas.

name: Grass-Fed Desi Cow Ghee (Bilona)
description: Golden granular ghee hand-crafted using Vedic wooden bilona churning over gentle firewood flame. Divine nutty aroma.

name: Spiced Moru Buttermilk (Neer Mor)
description: Refreshing churned buttermilk infused with crushed ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, and pink Himalayan rock salt.

name: Aged Farmstead Cheddar Cheese
description: Nilgiris mountain cave-aged mild cheddar. Made without chemical rennet or artificial food coloring.

name: Pure Thick Dairy Cream (Malai)
description: Rich 40% fat unpasteurized fresh clotted malai spooned from slow-simmered whole milk. Outstanding for desserts and gravies.

name: Badam & Saffron Flavoured Milk
description: Slow-reduced whole milk infused with crushed Mamra almonds, Kashmiri saffron strands, and green cardamom.

name: Traditional Sweet Mango Lassi
description: Rich artisanal yoghurt blended with sweet Alphonso mango pulp and cardamom. Thick, velvety, and cooling.

name: Fresh Root Coriander (Kothamalli)
description: Fresh native coriander with roots and soil intact for extended refrigerator life. Highly aromatic citrus-pine herbal note.

name: Fragrant Country Pudina (Mint)
description: Small-leaf intense country mint. Essential for spicy thuvaiyal, biryani layering, and cooling herbal tea infusions.

name: Salem Whole Golden Turmeric (Viral Manjal)
description: Salem finger turmeric renowned for high 5%+ curcumin content. Natural anti-inflammatory power without chemical lead coloring.

name: Juicy Mountain Fresh Ginger (Inji)
description: Young, non-fibrous high-altitude ginger with paper-thin skin. Delivers pungent zesty zing to chai, curries, and remedies.

name: Hill Country Garlic (Malai Poondu)
description: GI-tagged Kodaikanal Malai Poondu with intense medicinal potency, rich allicin oils, and distinctive purplish papery husks.

name: Malabar Tellicherry Black Pepper
description: King of Spices. Extra-bold 4.25mm Tellicherry black peppercorns bursting with intense piperine pungency and complex citrus notes.

name: Whole Fragrant Cumin Seeds (Jeeragam)
description: Sun-dried whole cumin seeds with warm, earthy, and nutty profile. Essential for digestive jeera water and aromatic tempering.

name: Green Cardamom Pods (Elaichi)
description: 8mm bold green cardamom pods grown in shade under rainforest canopies. Sweet eucalyptus aroma and intense essential oils.

name: True Ceylon Cinnamon Quills
description: Thin multi-layered true Ceylon cinnamon quills. Naturally low in coumarin, gentle on the liver, and sweet in herbal teas.

name: Fresh Garden Curry Leaves (Kariveppilai)
description: Dark green medicinal curry leaves picked at dawn. Packed with iron and essential oils that define authentic South Indian cuisine.
